groupings.title: NestJS
groupings.description: Reference skill for NestJS — the progressive, TypeScript-first Node.js framework. Covers controllers, providers & dependency injection, modules, the request pipeline (middleware, guards, interceptors, pipes, exception filters), validation, configuration, databases (TypeORM/Sequelize/Mongoose/Prisma), security & auth, GraphQL, WebSockets, microservices, OpenAPI/Swagger, testing, the nest CLI, and deployment.
